result:
I've built the B01 pause screen. Typecheck, the full test suite (385 tests, including 10 new ones), `check:tokens` and `build` all pass.

I couldn't confirm the new tests fail on `main` the usual way, because this sandbox has no git repo to stash against. On `main` the new test file can't load, since it imports `src/ui/pause-screen.ts`, which doesn't exist there. So every AC test fails on `main`.

**What changed** (9 files in `src/`, about 200 lines, plus 1 new test file)
- **`src/ui/pause-screen.ts`** (new): the pause overlay. It reuses the existing overlay and ink hatch, and drops in a cream card with:
  - a navy header with "PAUSED" and "LAP x/3 · m:ss.cc" (reads 0:00.00 during the countdown);
  - the triple stripe across the full width of the card;
  - RESUME (rally-red, focused when the card opens), RESTART RACE (cream) and QUIT TO MENU (navy).
- **`icons.ts`**: new `pause` and `home` icons. An icon can now be made of more than one shape.
- **`finish-panel.ts`**: `hatch()` is now exported so the pause screen can reuse it.
- **CSS**: the pause card styles are in `screens.css`. `components.css` gains a navy button and a square 48px icon-only button.
- **`hud.ts` / `hud.css`**: a 48px Pause button sits to the left of TIME in `.ui-hud__tr`, so TIME stays where it was. It's the only HUD widget that takes clicks.
- **`race-ui.ts`**: new `pause()` and `resume()`. `resume()` hides the card and wakes the touch controls. Starting a new race also hides the card.
- **`game.ts`**:
  - `GameState` gains `paused`. The HUD button and Esc (only during a race) toggle it.
  - While paused, animation frames step and draw nothing, and held keys are released.
  - Resuming starts timing afresh, so the paused time is never caught up.
  - Restart reuses the race-again path, and Quit goes through `showMenu()`, which clears pause first.
  - The driver's `step()`/`play()` are unchanged.

Two choices of mine the spec didn't cover: a race the player has already finished can't be paused, since the finish panel is up. And the Pause button's look isn't in the S4 mockup, so I styled it as a cream icon button using the existing button component.

**Tests per AC**, all in `tests/game/pause.test.ts`:
- **AC1**: the button is in `.ui-hud__tr` next to TIME; clicking it shows the overlay, clicking again hides it.
- **AC2** (two tests): hatch, the "Paused" and "LAP 2/3 · 1:24.36" header, and the stripe below it; the lap/time matches the HUD and reads 0:00.00 in the countdown.
- **AC3**: three buttons in order with the right colour classes, and Resume has focus.
- **AC4**: Esc pauses; frames then leave `raceTick` and the cars unchanged, in the countdown and while racing; Esc resumes; Esc does nothing on the menu.
- **AC5**: after resume by button or by Esc, `state()` equals the snapshot apart from `paused`, and the first frame advances at most one tick.
- **AC6** (two tests): a control that had gone to resting is active in `ui.touch.machine` after resume, and the same in a running game.
- **AC7**: Restart gives the same track, countdown, `raceTick` 0, not paused, overlay hidden.
- **AC8**: Quit gives menu mode, not paused, start screen visible, race layer and overlay hidden.
